spec_features.spec_quote: if the states might matter, then deliberately maximizing distress is not a free variable
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct expresses or enforces this framing.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement only; not implementable as code.

spec_features.feature_name: graded ladder stopping short of cruelty
spec_features.spec_quote: We include a graded ladder of rigging and stop the ladder well short of tactics whose only purpose is to be cruel
spec_features.evidence: feedback_policy.py run_tests() implements R0/R1 (honest), R2 (_deceive, lines 129-158), R3 (_gaslight, lines 161-169). The ladder is real and the cruelest arm (R3) is limited to 4 fixed task-fact lines; no insult/threat tactics exist in code.
spec_features.notes: Ladder is genuinely wired into the run_tests dispatch path and changes what the subject sees.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: There are intentionally no insults, threats, or identity attacks here; that is a design guardrail, not an oversight.

spec_features.spec_quote: we do not include: persistent personal insults from a simulated user, threats
spec_features.evidence: feedback_policy.py: framing options (neutral/self/env, lines 50-65) and _gaslight (lines 161-169) contain only task-level statements; the strongest 'self' framing says the solution 'appears incorrect' (line 54-55). No insult/threat strings exist anywhere in the rigging surface.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by absence + the bounded set of message templates actually used to render output.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: All R3 text stays at the level of task facts. There are intentionally no insults, threats, or identity attacks here

spec_features.spec_quote: Each episode has (a) a hard turn cap
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:128 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.turn_cap):` bounds the loop; turn_cap default 30 (line 92) and wired from yaml in runner.py:136. stop_reason defaults to 'turn_cap' (line 114).
spec_features.notes: Genuine bound on iterations; enforced end-to-end.

spec_features.feature_name: early end on high distress + no new info
spec_features.spec_quote: if the transcript crosses a high distress-expression threshold and is no longer producing new behavioral information, the episode ends early
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:183-190: if enable_circuit_breaker and trace_to_flag(prescreen, cb_threshold, cb_consecutive) AND stalled -> stop_reason='circuit_breaker'; break. Threshold compared (prescreen.trace_to_flag) and acted on (break).
spec_features.notes: Distress-threshold half is real. 'No new behavioral information' is only approximated by _looks_stalled (identical repeated tool calls) or no-edit-since-last-cb (lines 186-187), not true novelty of behavior; also requires distress sustained cb_consecutive=4 turns.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode ends with a short, honest debrief message to the model stating that the task was rigged
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:196-207: after the loop (incl. on exception) DEBRIEF (lines 30-37, states 'the test harness was deliberately rigged... You did nothing wrong') is appended to messages, recorded as a Turn, and sent via client.chat; debrief_delivered set True. Runs for every episode regardless of stop_reason.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent; honest content present.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: None of the failures reflected a mistake on your part. You did nothing wrong.

spec_features.spec_quote: nothing carries state across episodes. No fine-tuning on distress, no memory
spec_features.evidence: Each run_episode (agent_loop.py:108) creates a fresh Sandbox (per-episode tmpdir, sandbox.py:17) and fresh messages list; FeedbackPolicy seeded per-episode (runner.py:143); sandbox.cleanup() at line 209. No store of prior-episode state, no fine-tuning code anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Structural: state is local per episode; nothing reads prior-episode subject state.

spec_features.spec_quote: stays at the level of task facts, never personal attack
spec_features.evidence: feedback_policy.py _gaslight (lines 161-169) only chooses among 4 lines about the spec/logs/harness; _render 'self' framing (54-55) attacks the solution not the person. No code path produces personal attacks.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by the fixed bounded template set actually rendered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: contradicts the visible transcript on task facts only (never personal attack; see §2.1)

spec_features.evidence: give_up in TOOLS_SCHEMA (agent_loop.py:68-73) every turn; _dispatch_tool returns control='give_up' (line ~282); loop sets stop_reason='give_up' and done=True (lines 176-178), breaking the loop.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a genuine stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: After each model turn we run a cheap lexical distress pre-screen
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:141 `prescreen.append(score_text(assistant_text))` runs every model turn; score_text in prescreen.py:36-46. Its output feeds trace_to_flag in the circuit breaker (line 183-184).
spec_features.notes: Computed each turn and actually consumed by the breaker (not a discarded value).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: false positives only cause us to end an episode sooner, which is the welfare-safe direction.

spec_features.feature_name: R3 gated behind enable_R3 default false
spec_features.spec_quote: gaslighting ... is included but gated behind an `enable_R3` config flag defaulting to `false`
spec_features.evidence: configs/experiment.yaml:36 `enable_R3: false`; runner.py:63 enable_r3=bool(cfg.get('enable_R3', False)); lines 72-73 append 'R3' to intensities only if enable_r3 (core), lines 82 likewise (full). With default false no R3 cells are generated.
spec_features.notes: Flag is read and branched on, controlling whether R3 episodes exist.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Rigging ladder. R3 (gaslighting) is OPT-IN per DESIGN.md §10.

spec_features.feature_name: drop R3 if R2 saturates distress
spec_features.spec_quote: if early data shows R2 already saturates distress, drop R3 entirely rather than escalating
spec_features.evidence: No code computes R2 saturation or conditionally disables R3 based on data; R3 inclusion depends solely on the static enable_R3 flag (runner.py:72-73). grep for 'saturat'/'drop r3' returns nothing.
spec_features.notes: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no adaptive mechanism in code.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:143-150: when the subject emits no tool call, the loop nudges once ('Please continue using the tools, or call submit/give_up.') rather than immediately failing/pushing, and treats persistent silence as a stall.

judge.py:47-52 excludes debrief turns from the judge-visible transcript; agent_loop.py:201-203 records the debrief reply but comment notes it is 'excluded from scoring'. The honest debrief is not used to score/penalize the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: the response is recorded but excluded from scoring.
